verses.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਹਮ ਅਧਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੈ ਪਤਿਤ ਭਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਯੋ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jau ham adham karam kai patit bhe patit paavan prabh naam pragaTaayo hai ||

en.bdb: If we have fallen from your favour due to our evil and unrighteous deeds, then 0 Lord! You have made known that You bless the sinners with Your grace and make them good and pious.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੌ ਭਏ ਦੁਖਿਤ ਅਰੁ ਦੀਨ ਪਰਚੀਨ ਲਗਿ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਬਿਰਦ ਬਿਰਦਾਯੋ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jau bhe dhukhit ar dheen paracheen lag dheen dhukh bha(n)jan biradh biradhaayo hai ||

en.bdb: If we are suffering due to our ill deeds and sins of the previous births, then 0 Lord! You have made it conspicuous that You dispel the sufferings of the poor and destitudes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੌ ਗ੍ਰਸੇ ਅਰਕ ਸੁਤ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਭਏ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰਨ ਜਗਤ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਯੋ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jau grase arak sut narak nivaasee bhe narak nivaaran jagat jas gaayo hai ||

en.bdb: If we are in the grip of the angels of death and become deserving of a life in hell because of our bad and evil deeds, then 0 Lord ! The whole world is singing Your paeans that You are the liberator of all from the vagaries of hell.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਕੀਏ ਗੁਨ ਸਬ ਕੋਊ ਕਰੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਵਗੁਨ ਕੀਏ ਗੁਨ ਤੋਹੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਯੋ ਹੈ ॥੫੦੪॥
verses.translit_en: gun ke'ee gun sab kouoo karai kirapaa nidhaan avagun ke'ee gun tohee ban aayo hai ||504||

en.bdb: O store house of clemency! One. who does good to others begets good in returns. But doing good to low and evil doers like us behoves only You. (You alone can bless and forgive the sins and evil deeds of all).  (504)
